items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Parker... used to come over and play with us all the time.

ctx.x: Well, the musician impression of it, I liked the music, and Charlie Parker and Dizzy Gillespie and all of these people who started in that era. But it wasn't danceable. This is why it didn't live. Outrageous tempos and the passages that they would play were -- a lot of execution and running and different things like that.
So it kind of -- people had been listening to Swing and they'd been listening to danceable music. It was good jazz, but danceably.
